summary: Wrote a seven-phase plan that rules first and implements second. Phases 1-2 produce the branch-topology decision record (hot-path commits stay on the already-checked-out branch; milestone review history is built by git commit-tree/update-ref, never checkout; worktree isolation not reinstated, with the recorded data-loss mechanism engaged) plus the one dependency edge and task-description revision it justifies. Phases 3-7 build the milestone-ref landing script, verify the landing before any completion status write, prepare the milestone push/review handoff through the existing /please + /merge grant path without ever pushing, and reconcile the Branch Strategy standard. Premise re-validation corrected two stale carried figures and found the milestone schema already carries review.state 'prepared' and review.ref, so no new status vocabulary is invented.

artifacts.summary: Seven-phase implementation plan for the branch-topology ruling and the milestone automation and review gates built on it.
